verdict.rationale: cfo.ai documents pulling Actuals from QuickBooks, Xero, NetSuite or Rillet alongside forecasts. It says Ari can answer 'why spending went up', and outputs print lineage back to the source line, which approximates variance explanation and drill-down. It never explicitly documents a budget-vs-actuals report or department/account slicing. missing for 10: explicit budget-vs-actuals/variance reporting, documented breakdown by department and account (Dimensions are only named generically), explicit transaction-level drill-down from a variance, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, budget-vs-actuals runs by department and account, with drill-down into the transactions behind a variance

citations.quote: Bring in Actuals from QuickBooks, Xero, NetSuite, or Rillet.
Each one prints its lineage back to the source line.
Forecast revenue, costs, and cash from what drives your business.
